Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.candidate_matching_input: the displayed V48 transfer is the zero-finite-part point for Hc-Hc and odd-profile H-Hc/O7/O8 coefficients; zero is not symmetry-enforced, the complete EFT must retain and renormalize them, and generic values change the wall generator already at O(1)
Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.endpoint_parity: on the doubled cover H is even and Hc is odd, but the exact strong wall has Hc slope proportional to Lambda/epsilon

exact_m0_strong_collar.even_profile_Hc_Hc: (1/3) h0^T Lambda^T Xi Lambda h0 = O(1)
exact_m0_strong_collar.general_quadratic_generator: d(f,g)/dy=[[-rho A^T,mI-rho Xi],[rho Lambda-mI,rho A]](f,g), up to the fixed orientation convention

Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.excluded_singular_scalings: Hc-Hc coefficients growing as 1/epsilon^2 lie outside the declared O(1) Wilsonian domain and define a different singular regulator
Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.finite_epsilon_scope: generic O(1) Hc-Hc or odd-profile coefficients modify the full finite-epsilon wall generator; the displayed exact V48 transfer is therefore not a stable complete-action pencil
Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.naive_smooth_profile_warning: holding hc1 fixed while epsilon tends to zero gives apparent O(epsilon) and O(epsilon^2) suppression, but that assumption is inconsistent with the exact Lambda/epsilon wall, where hc1=-Lambda h0/epsilon
Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.normalized_profile_moments: integral rho_double s^(2n+1) ds=0 and integral rho_double s^(2n) ds=epsilon^(2n)/(2n+1)
Hc_and_mixed_operator_power_counting.radiative_statement: orbifold parity kills only the even-profile H-Hc average; symmetry-respecting matching or loops may generate odd-profile and Hc-Hc coefficients, which cannot be assigned to the O(E^2/Lambda^2) remainder in the strong collar

counterterm_and_gate_scope.G2_statement: this closes the regulator microscopic-candidate condition only; G2 requires the independent complete boundary-EFT operator and Wilson-matching verdict
counterterm_and_gate_scope.G6_statement: full KK root and threshold sums are G6 work, not a G2 regulator condition
not_enumerated_here: gauge and source-dependent gauge kinetic functions
counterterm_and_gate_scope.quadratic_H_sector_inputs: independent H Kahler, normal-derivative, H-Hc and Hc-Hc finite counterterms are specified at the matching scale; the certificate point selects their finite parts to zero

exact_finite_epsilon_boundary_pencil.factorization: K_res=D K_eff where D is invertible
exact_finite_epsilon_boundary_pencil.self_adjointness: the V48 Hermitian Lambda, canonical H/Hc norm, g(L)=0 and J-unitary transfer proof apply unchanged
exact_finite_epsilon_boundary_pencil.thin_wall: after solving the full collar, epsilon->0 gives the V47 K(m)
exact_finite_epsilon_boundary_pencil.zero_energy: B_epsilon(0)=Lambda exactly, so tau_L,tau_R nonzero leave zero exotic modes

gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.axial_gauge_certificate: on the simply connected collar choose the trivial supersymmetric Wilson-line background and Phi_5=0; then U=I and the H/Hc quadratic operator is exactly V48's square source Lambda/epsilon
gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.interaction: integral_[L-epsilon,L] dy rho_epsilon [kappa_L ThetaPlus Hhat_LF Hhat_LA/Mstar + kappa_R ThetaMinus Hhat_RA Hhat_RF/Mstar + kappa_16 barSigma Hhat_LF Hhat_RA/Mstar + kappa_bar16 Sigma Hhat_LA Hhat_RF/Mstar]
gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.local_gauge_statement: each transported bilinear and its source field transform at y=L, so every contraction is Spin(10)xU(1)F invariant
gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.nonlocality_scope: the shortest normal Wilson line is part of the declared finite-resolution kernel; it is not evidence for point-local five-dimensional UV completion
gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.one_sided_normalization: for every orbifold-even integrand F, integral_-epsilon^epsilon rho_double F = integral_0^epsilon rho_physical F; this is the convention used by the physical H/Hc transfer
gauge_covariant_fixed_smearing.profile: on the doubled endpoint cover use the even rho_double(s)=1/(2epsilon) for |s|<epsilon, integral one; its quotient physical-half density for parity-even operators is rho_physical=1/epsilon on 0<s<epsilon, also integral one

scope.V48_repair: the y-dependent source-field collar and its transverse-mass claim are superseded; the exact H/Hc square-collar transfer remains valid
scope.answer: yes: keep the V47 fields strictly four-dimensional and smear only their gauge-covariant interaction kernel
scope.question: Can the V48 H/Hc collar be sourced by the dynamical V47 wall fields without inventing an uncontrolled source KK continuum?

strictly_4D_source_action.action: integral d4x [integral d4theta K_V47(X,Xdagger,V(L)) + integral d2theta W_source,V47(X)+h.c.]
strictly_4D_source_action.location: four-dimensional N=1 source theory at y=L
strictly_4D_source_action.no_source_KK_tower: X_A depends on x and theta only, not y; rho_epsilon belongs solely to the interaction kernel
strictly_4D_source_action.normalization: no y integration occurs in the source kinetic action; the V47 canonical normalization, dimension-one VEVs, F/D equations and 443-mode physical Hessian are unchanged
strictly_4D_source_action.source_spectrum: exactly the already-audited V47 four-dimensional source spectrum; no transverse source label or source-wall KK determinant exists

variation_and_quadratic_reduction.delta_H: variation gives rho_epsilon U_R(L,y)^T times the symmetric source mass acting on transported H
variation_and_quadratic_reduction.delta_Wilson_line: variations of U contain at least two H fields and one gauge fluctuation, hence are cubic and absent from the quadratic H/Hc spectral pencil about H=0
variation_and_quadratic_reduction.delta_source_fields: delta W/dX_A equals the V47 source F-term plus the normalized integral of the corresponding transported H bilinear
variation_and_quadratic_reduction.vacuum: at H=0 the second term vanishes, so the exact V47 F-flat/D-flat source branch and Hessian remain unchanged
